concept.title: Inline elements in every block context
concept.shortdesc: Open Settings, run sync, and read the intro.

conbody.p: Click Save, run npm test, see the product, define dwell time, edit config.json, open Options, and follow the next topic with .

ul.li: Click Add and run add for each item.
Each zone lives in zones.csv under Zones per the zone guide.

conbody.note: Press Reset, run reset, keep the defaults, check baseline, open reset.log in Log viewer, and see resetting.

row.entry: Click Export or run export for the report.

entry.p: The trip count is in trips.csv under Trips; see trips.

dd.p: Choose Origin, pass --origin, name the zone, a trip end in origins.csv under Origins; see origins.

section.title: Section context
section.p: Select Run, call run(), for the query, a segment in run.sql under Query; see running.
